text:
Type: drop-leaf dining table with drawer
Use: dining, small meals, saving space; kitchen, dining nook, small apartment
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted solid wood and wood-based panels in white, dark metal knob
Colors: white, black
Shape: rectangular top with two hinged folding leaves, small center drawer, turned legs, low stretchers, compact when folded
Feel: charming, practical, fresh, homey
Goes with: white or wood chairs, pale walls, pastel accents; farmhouse, cottage or classic kitchens and small dining rooms

product.name: INGATORP
product.description: Table with drop-leaves seats 2-4; makes it possible to adjust the table size according to need.
